goal: Replace the desktop UI's unconditional two-second Python strands polling with the existing Rust .forseti file-change event while preserving initial load, coalescing, visible slow-read state, and offline testability.
prohibited_actions: run Tauri build or desktop integration tests
use Accessibility, AX, osascript, cliclick, foreground-window automation, mouse, or keyboard automation
acceptance: The product UI subscribes to window.__TAURI__.event.listen for forseti://changed before requesting its initial refresh.
The product UI contains no setInterval(tick, ...) or setInterval(loadFoundation, ...) loop.
Same-turn event bursts coalesce, and events arriving during an in-flight refresh cause at most one trailing refresh rather than being lost or spawning overlap.
Repository-change refresh invalidates backend-derived view caches and refreshes the foundation state without moving decision logic into Rust or JavaScript.
A slow Python read becomes visibly observable through a one-shot timer, and the timer is cleared on completion or failure.
The offline harness can emit deterministic synthetic forseti://changed events, and focused static/render contracts are updated to test event-driven behavior rather than product polling.
No Forseti.app, Tauri build, deployment, AX, Accessibility, mouse, keyboard, foreground-window, or live UI action occurs.
done_definition: SUBMITTED only; an independent verifier must rerun the offline checks before VERIFIED_COMPLETE. This task never unlocks or authorizes FOR-P2-001.
